evals.name: boolean-props-to-compound
evals.prompt: Refactor a Composer-like component with isThread, isEditing, isDMThread boolean props into compound subcomponents with shared context.
evals.expected_output: Explicit variant components or compound API; no exponential boolean conditionals.
assertions: Uses compound components or explicit variants
Uses React 19 use() not useContext when showing context access
Does not use forwardRef wrapper for ref passthrough

evals.name: luxe-table-reference
evals.prompt: We already have Table.Root Table.Grid Table.Pagination — explain how this matches compound component pattern for new domain UI.
evals.expected_output: Maps vercel composition rules to existing @/components/table/data-table compound API.
assertions: References existing Table compound component as Luxe precedent
Recommends extending Table not raw useReactTable in domains
